# PhysxMeshMergeCollisionAPI

Merges the meshes of its built-in collisionmeshes collection into one collision mesh for the collider it is applied to; no column of the API is read. The runtime checks its presence only in scene queries, which accept a [prim](glossary.md#prim) with this API as a shape or mesh query input although it is not a [Gprim](glossary.md#gprim) or [Mesh](glossary.md#mesh).

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Requires on the same prim:** [`PhysicsCollisionAPI`](PhysicsCollisionAPI.md)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Interactions

- **[`CollectionAPI`](CollectionAPI.md):** Both walkers treat the API as a registered custom shape and build one merged mesh from the members of CollectionAPI:collisionmeshes on the same prim, with the collider's physics:approximation: members in path order, faces reversed to right-handed where the member is left-handed or its transform reflects, members with inconsistent topology skipped. A collider whose members supply no geometry emits no shape. Direct Gprim children of the collider are populated through collider_child_geometry and direct collection targets through physics_target; a member reached only by expanding another target needs the rendering domain to supply its geometry.
